title: 3000 CNY bounded-loss high-volatility ETF breakout sleeve
hypothesis: A fixed long-only breakout rule can concentrate a 3000 CNY sleeve into persistent high-volatility ETF trends while limiting losses to the funded sleeve and avoiding leverage.
economic_mechanism: Behavioral underreaction and slow institutional/retail fund flows can create trend persistence after multi-month price breakouts; false breakouts pay for the infrequent large winners.

method.signal_at_close: close strictly above the highest close of the prior 55 trading days
method.selection: highest 63-trading-day return among simultaneous breakouts; symbol ascending as deterministic tie-break
method.exit_at_close: close strictly below the lowest close of the prior 20 trading days

known_limits: The universe uses present-day knowledge and has survivorship and selection bias.
Daily bars cannot prove stop or next-open fill quality during gaps.
This qualification period is not a pristine untouched holdout.
A total loss of the 3000 CNY sleeve remains possible.
next_step_if_pass: start a 90-day forward local paper sleeve without changing parameters
next_step_if_fail: reject this exact rule without tuning the qualification period
